description: 📌 Checkmyguest offers you this exceptional 120 m² apartment on the 6th floor with elevator, offering a breathtaking view of the Eiffel Tower! Located on Avenue de Suffren, in the heart of the prestigious 7th arrondissement, you will be a stone's throw from the Champ-de-Mars, Les Invalides, and the banks of the Seine.The space⭐ Located on the 6th floor of a Parisian building with an elevator, this exceptional 120 m² apartment offers a rare and privileged setting in the heart of the 7th arrondissement. Bathed in light, it features spectacular views of the Eiffel Tower from its large windows and long balcony — a true Parisian tableau accompanying every moment of your stay.📍 Situated on Avenue de Suffren, you’ll enjoy an elegant, ultra-central environment, just steps from the Champ-de-Mars, École Militaire, the Seine quays, and minutes from Les Invalides or Saint-Germain-des-Prés. Shops, restaurants, cafés, bakeries, and public transport are right at your doorstep, making it easy to explore Paris.⭐ A space designed for your comfort:✔️ A spacious, bright living room with sofa, armchairs, TV, and a dining table, opening onto a long balcony with stunning views of the Eiffel Tower and Paris rooftops.✔️ A modern, fully equipped kitchen: coffee machine, Nespresso machine, kettle, oven, microwave, toaster, dishwasher, utensils… everything needed to cook at home.✔️ Three comfortable bedrooms:• Two with queen-size beds• One with two single beds✔️ One bathroom with bathtub and shower✔️ A second bathroom with shower✔️ Two separate toilets✔️ Washer and dryer for a fully independent stay✔️ TV & high-speed Internet✔️ It is possible to reserve a parking space with your rental for an additional fee. Please contact us for more information. 📍 Apartment highlights:📶 High-speed WiFi included🧺
